findings.claim: The exam tip says theatre-role identification questions may be worth 1 or 2 marks, with a separate 4-mark role question.
findings.truth: Section A of the written paper has four 1-mark multiple-choice questions on professional theatre maker roles and/or terminology.
findings.evidence: spec 4.2 Assessment components, Section A: Theatre roles and terminology

findings.claim: The lesson presents scale as the single most fundamental design element and calls four named examples the complete set of design fundamentals.
findings.truth: The specification names scale, shape, colour and texture as design fundamentals using 'such as'. It neither ranks one as most fundamental nor presents the list as exhaustive.
findings.evidence: spec 3.1.1, Drama and theatre terminology and how to use it appropriately

findings.truth: Where the paper offers a designer perspective, the specification includes lighting, sound, set, costume and puppets.
findings.evidence: spec 4.2 Assessment components, Section B: Study of set text

findings.claim: The lesson attributes incorrect vocal and physical lists to the specification, omitting specified terms and adding others as if specified.
findings.truth: The specification gives vocal examples of accent, volume, pitch, timing, pace, intonation, phrasing, emotional range and delivery of lines; its physical examples are build, age, height, facial features, movement, posture, gesture and facial expression.
findings.evidence: spec 3.1.1, performers' vocal and physical interpretation of character

findings.claim: The exam tip says every 20-mark response must address both performer and designer choices and caps a performance-only answer.
findings.truth: One part of Section B offers a choice of writing as a performer or as a designer. The specification does not impose the stated combined-response rule or cap.
findings.evidence: spec 4.2 Assessment components, Section B: Study of set text

summary: Checked all five lessons against the specification. Five verified findings require thirteen surgical edits.
